## 题目

已知 $\triangle {ABC}$ 中, $\angle C = {90}^{ \circ  }, D$ 为 ${AC}$ 上一点, $K$ 为 ${BD}$ 上一点,且 $\angle {ABC} = \; \angle {KAD} = \angle {AKD}$ . 证明: ${BK} = {2DC}$ .

## 参考解答

::: {.callout-important title="标准解答" collapse="false"}
如图,在 ${BD}$ 的延长线上取点 $E$ ,使得 ${KD} = {DE}$ ,结合题设条件,有 $\triangle {KAE}$ 是直角三角形,又 $\angle {EKA} = \angle {ABC}$ ,则 $\triangle {AKE} \backsim  \triangle {CBA}$ ,因此

$$
\frac{AE}{KE} = \frac{CA}{BA},
$$

①

$\angle {BAD} = \angle {BEA}$ . 又 $\angle {DBA} = \angle {EBA}$ ,所以 $\triangle {ABD} \backsim  \triangle {EBA}$ ,则

$$
\frac{AB}{AD} = \frac{EB}{EA}.
$$

②

将①，②两式相乘，得 $\frac{AC}{AD} = \frac{BE}{KE}$ ，所以 ${BE} = {2AC}$ ，因此

$$
{BK} = {BE} - {KE} = {2AC} - {2AD} = {2CD}.
$$

原问题得证.

![](../images/157_983_620_247_428_0.jpg)
:::
